strongest_angle: Explore the breakthrough indictment of 67-year-old David Alexander Williams in the 1986 murder and rape of 23-year-old Teresa Ann Houck in Druid Hill Park, nearly four decades later.

key_facts.fact: Sixty-seven-year-old David Alexander Williams was indicted on murder, rape, and handgun charges in connection with the 1986 homicide of Teresa Ann Houck in Druid Hill Park.
Baltimore City State’s Attorney Ivan J. Bates announced charges against David Alexander Williams for the fatal shooting of 23-year-old Teresa Ann Houck in October 1986.
key_facts.source_name: Office of the State's Attorney for Baltimore City

key_facts.fact: The suspect David Alexander Williams was already an incarcerated man in Maryland, previously convicted of his wife's murder, when he was linked to the 1986 Baltimore cold case.
